---
name: Bug report
about: Report a reproducible Cabane problem
---

## What happened

Describe expected and observed behaviour.

## Reproduce

Give minimal steps using the demo or a synthetic home.

## Environment

Cabane version or public commit, browser, device and standalone/native-panel host.

## Evidence

Include sanitised errors or screenshots if useful. Do not include credentials,
household entity IDs, private exports, camera media, addresses or personal plans.
Report vulnerabilities privately as described in SECURITY.md.
